what: DEFECT H10.2-3 repro: `atlas run --workspace <scratch>` with a real model; model wrote to the CLI process launch dir instead of the workspace
command: python -m atlas.cli run -p <Chinese write-file prompt> --workspace C:/Users/25011/AppData/Local/Temp/h1-k-ws/live-root/workspaces/probe-write2 --model deepseek-v4.1-flash --output-format stream-json (launched with cwd=D:/Atlas-h1-core-hardening)

observed.tool_arguments_path: D:\Atlas-h1-core-hardening\hello.txt (repo root, outside --workspace; file was really created there)

static_root_cause: core/atlas/engine/hermes_runtime.py:968 passes cwd=hermes_cwd(=workspace) to the AIAgent factory
fork agent/agent_init.py:2434 stores it as agent.session_cwd

but the system prompt's 'Current working directory' comes from resolve_agent_cwd() (fork agent/prompt_builder.py:1046 -> fork agent/runtime_cwd.py:105-107), which reads only the _SESSION_CWD context var / TERMINAL_CWD env and falls back to os.getcwd() (the process launch dir)
no Atlas code calls set_session_cwd (grep: zero callers in core/atlas; fork callers are acp_adapter/gateway/tui only)
impact: real model obeys the leaked cwd and writes outside the requested workspace; desktop backend launch dir likely the install root -> same hazard
